title: FABIAN-variant 2026: improved prediction of the effects of DNA variants on transcription factor binding.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Fetched the web server landing page (HTTP 200 on GET, HTML only; HEAD returns 404). Europe PMC supplement listing contains only 8 figure images (0.41 MB zip), no data tables. Full text has no GEO/Zenodo/Dryad accessions; the data availability statement points only to the web server.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Counts of >40,000 motif models for >1,500 human TFs (transcription factors), BPNet (a neural network for TF binding) scores for 240 TFs, and the SNP-SELEX (an in-vitro assay measuring allele-specific TF binding) comparison on 144,305 variant–TF pairs; FABIAN-variant 2022 ranking 4th of 14 models in the Han et al. 2024 benchmark.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset; only an interactive web server/API that computes predictions on user-submitted variants. Checked: supplement holds only figures.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No label table exists in this resource; any training table would have to be constructed by querying the tool or by importing SNP-SELEX from another paper.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs would be genomic coordinates plus reference genome sequence, retrievable without lookups; not tested.

a4_units_stated.note: Scores (combined score, PWM/TFFM score differences) are defined in the methods; read in paper only.

a5_enough_rows.note: No row-level data to count; the SNP-SELEX comparison set is 144,305 pairs per paper text only.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No downloadable file to compare against the paper's counts.

a8_label_provenance.note: Everything the resource produces is itself a model's prediction (motif-matrix scores, BPNet outputs), so training on it would distill FABIAN. The only measured label (SNP-SELEX) belongs to a different paper and is already benchmarked with 14 models.

existing_models.name: FABIAN-variant 2022/2026 (motif-matrix and BPNet scoring web tool)
existing_models.score_and_split: 2022 version: median per-TF AUROC (area under the ROC curve) 0.906 First Batch, 0.689 Novel Batch of SNP-SELEX, as reported in this paper's text
existing_models.authors_named_unsolved: Not retrieved as an explicit statement.

honest_claim_h3: Any model trained on this resource would only claim to reproduce FABIAN-variant's own motif-based predictions, not measured TF binding.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the DNA sequence around a variant to predict whether it strengthens or weakens a transcription factor's binding.
plain_idea.train_on: Variant–transcription factor pairs with sequence context; this paper deposits none, so the count from this resource is unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Change in binding; here it would come from FABIAN's own computed scores, not from a measurement, unless SNP-SELEX in-vitro binding data from another paper is used.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Clinical geneticists interpreting non-coding variants need binding-effect predictions, but this resource is a tool, not a training dataset.

ml_idea: None viable from this resource: it is a prediction web server with no deposited measurements; the measured benchmark (SNP-SELEX) is a separate, already heavily benchmarked dataset.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Look for a deposited table of measured labels: none found (supplement is figures only).

verdict_reason: Software/web-server paper with no deposited dataset; its outputs are model predictions (A8 circularity) and no label column exists (A1, A2). The only measured labels come from SNP-SELEX, a separate dataset already benchmarked against 14 models.
